name: Land Legs
body:
Bane: You suffer a -2 penalty on Acrobatics, Climb, and Swim checks when aboard any waterborne vessel, or in water deeper than your height, and cannot take 10 with these skills under such conditions. You may not take levels in Profession (sailor) or any equivalent water-based profession skill.
